spans.s:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Sewn, stitched.
m. (-तः)
A sack.
E.
(-षिव) to sew, aff. क्त.

f. (-तिः)
1 Sewing, stitching, working with needle and thread.
2 Offspring, lineage.
3 A sack.
E.
षिव to sew, aff. क्तिन्.

m. (-नः)
1 The sun.
2 A sack.
E.
षिव to sew, Uṇādi aff. न, and यूच् substituted for the last two radical letters; also with the vowel of the augment changed स्योन.

m. (-मः)
A ray of light.
E.
षिव to sew, मन् Uṇādi aff., and यूच् substituted for the radical finals.
